name: com.leaxor/leaxor
title: Leaxor
description: Generate AI images and video clips with Kling, Seedance, Flux and Nano Banana on Leaxor credits.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: How many Leaxor credits the user has left. One credit is $0.01. Check this before a big batch of generations.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: The image or video models Leaxor runs, with their ids and credit prices. Call it before generating when the user names a model, asks what's available, or cares about cost. For video, pass the mode: generate (text or image to video), frames (start and end frame) or reference (keep characters consistent from reference images).

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Make an image from a prompt. Charged to the user's Leaxor credits (10–30 credits depending on the model; list_models has each price). Most models finish within a minute and the image URL comes straight back. Slower models return an id instead: call get_image with it. Pass reference_images (https URLs) to edit or restyle a photo on models that accept them.

model.description: Model id from list_models. Defaults to flux-2-pro.

style.description: A style preset added to the prompt. Defaults to cinematic.

aspect.description: Shape of the image. Defaults to 9:16.

reference_images.description: Optional https image URLs to edit or follow.

tools.name: get_image
tools.description: Where a queued image stands, and its URL once it's done.

tools.name: generate_clip
tools.description: Start a video clip from a prompt, optionally from a start image (image to video), a start and end frame (mode frames), or reference images that keep a character consistent (mode reference). Charged to the user's Leaxor credits when it starts — the price depends on model and length, so check list_models first and tell the user the cost. Clips take one to five minutes: this returns an id, then call get_clip until it's done. A failed clip is refunded automatically.

model.description: Model id from list_models. Defaults to the mode's default model.

duration.description: Seconds, e.g. "5". Must be one the model offers (list_models).

aspect.description: e.g. "9:16", "16:9" or "1:1". Must be one the model offers.

resolution.description: Optional, e.g. 720p or 1080p, on models that offer it.

audio.description: Native sound, on models that support it. Usually costs more.

start_image.description: https URL of the opening frame. In generate mode this makes it image to video.

end_image.description: frames mode: https URL of the closing frame.

reference_images.description: reference mode: https URLs of the characters or objects to keep consistent.

tools.name: get_clip
tools.description: Where a clip stands, and its video URL once it's done. Poll every 30 seconds or so.

tools.name: list_recent
tools.description: The user's most recent images and clips, newest first, with their URLs.
